name: image-cropper
title: Image Cropper
description: Crop, straighten, turn and flip a photo without ever showing an empty corner: the photo scales and clamps itself to always cover the crop frame. Drag handles, aspect presets, a straighten dial, pinch, two-finger rotate, trackpad pinch and keyboard. Optional AI fill: go past the edges and a pluggable generateFill (an image model behind your server) fills the empty parts. Exports to Blob or canvas at full resolution.
docs: Give <ImageCropper> a src and a ref; call ref.current.toBlob() to export. For AI fill, pass generateFill and post the image and mask to a server route that calls your image model (key on the server only). Guide: https://github.com/Launch-Studio-Labs/launchstudio-labs/blob/main/skills/image-cropper/SKILL.md
